rules: Facts only, each with its source link. Items naming a person or using opinion words are dropped before publishing.
review_rules: Review checklist n27: primary source (developer page or official register) read on the review date; official per-project register looked up where one is public (Dubai DLD, RAK RERA list), result recorded; handover status resolved against the date on record; source quality recorded per field (registry, developer, press, portal); every fact with its source and date read.

pin_range: pin outside the valid latitude and longitude range, or at 0,0
date_impossible: handover or start year before 1990 or after 2050
pin_far: pin more than 150 km from the median pin of its place (places with 5 or more pins; country-wide places left out)
price_range: price from below USD 5,000 or above USD 150 million at a rough fixed rate
size_range: size below 8 m2 or above 50,000 m2, or minimum above maximum
start_after_handover: building start later than the promised handover
completed_future: stage "completed" while the handover on record is more than a year ahead
same_name: the same project name twice in one place
twin_pin: two projects of one place less than 25 m apart with similar names
